selective_sharing.note: Selective v1 is retained. This variant adds regularized species-specific deviations in nonlinear growth and treatment response. Deviations shrink toward the shared mean; they are not unpenalized species RE.

regularization.growth: ridge inflation on SPECIES × time-basis coefficients (lambda_growth)
regularization.transformer: phase1 target fit; phase2 extra L2 of species/growth tokens toward phase1 and treatment-deviation head toward 0
regularization.treatment: ridge inflation on SPECIES × exposure/dose coefficients (lambda_treatment)

selective_sharing.training: joint ridge with SPECIES×time (growth) and SPECIES×exposure (treatment) deviations; inflated ridge on those columns; HierarchicalCovariance on target-species OOF residuals only
